decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.topic: DEF-p4-char-301: the work order's prescribed mechanism could not be used
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.the_order_said: Keep the named gardeners' numerals and re-rank the soldiers.
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.what_was_done: The named gardeners' numerals were kept exactly as instructed, but the soldiers were NOT re-ranked - the gardeners moved suit instead.
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.why: Re-ranking the soldiers is arithmetically impossible. A suit has 13 cards. In the shared ch008 scene the claimants are 10 soldiers + 3 named gardeners (2/5/7, locked by the source) + 6 background gardeners + the King and Queen of Clubs on CHAR-visiting-monarchs-ensemble M01/M02 (whose own sheet was drawn as the King of Clubs) = 19 claims on 13 cards. Even dropping the background gardeners entirely it is 15 > 13, so no assignment of soldier ranks can clear the collision; some group has to leave the club suit.
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.why_the_gardeners_and_not_the_soldiers: SOUL arbitration rule - source text first, inferred yields to what is written. ch008-p11 'First came ten soldiers carrying clubs', read in parallel with 'the ten courtiers; these were ornamented all over with diamonds' and the heart-ornamented royal children, anchors the club suit to the soldiers, and ten soldiers need the suit's ten pip cards. The gardeners' suit appears nowhere in the source (only their numbers Two, Five and Seven do), so it is the free variable. Spades also fit garden staff and match the illustrated tradition. Bonus: the result is an exactly consistent single pack - clubs = 10 soldiers + 2 monarchs + 1 reserve, spades = 9 gardeners + 3 monarchs + 1 reserve, diamonds and hearts unchanged at 13 each.
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.cost_disclosed: The four H2-locked gardener sheets draw club trefoils, not spade pips. Nothing was regenerated (auto-reroll budget 0). The numerals - the only identifying feature and the only thing the source fixes - are unaffected, and costumes.json visual_en is already the wardrobe/pip authority for prompts under the runs/g4/gate.json DEF-p4-costume-sheet-901 waiver. CHAR-gardener-two's sheet is in any case already non-conforming (3 pips drawn instead of 2, logged in runs/p4-char-concept-cb3/result.json).
decisions_needing_orchestrator_attention.if_the_user_disagrees: The only other assignment that fits 13 cards is to move the SOLDIERS to spades (1 sheet glyph affected instead of 4) at the cost of the source's club-suit reading for the soldiers. Everything needed to flip it is one controlled change on the same ten files. Please surface this to the user at the next checkpoint rather than treating it as settled.
